title: Only 7% Pass This Word Association Test
summary: Explore Natural Connections, Objects and Functions, Science and Meaning, Language Patterns, The Final Word across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Follow the links between words.
Find the connection.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Natural Connections, Objects and Functions, Science and Meaning, Language Patterns, The Final Word. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz measures performance on these ten associations, not intelligence or cognitive ability.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
